# Anushk Kumar

Portfolio for Anushk Kumar, a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at IIIT Delhi. His public work explores applied AI, usable security, systems, GPU programming, and open source.

Canonical URL: https://berserk-23115.github.io
GitHub: https://github.com/berserk-23115
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/anushk-kumar-a0b7b61ba

The homepage, Computational Matter, contains profile details, four selected project chapters (Amber, KryptVault, GPU Video Processor, and RISC-V Assembler), technical disciplines, education, public pull-request evidence, and contact links. Procedural Three.js and SVG artwork illustrates the engineering themes. Essential content is accessible without WebGL. GitHub data is collected during static builds in /data/github.json, retains the last available snapshot when refresh fails, and never includes credentials. A native contribution calendar is available when build credentials are configured.
